BreakBoss: rebuilt FL-style step sequencer (original instrument faceplate is unchanged).

Please test:
- From the original faceplate, open the step sequencer. Verify three panels: generation/MIDI on the left, channel rack in the center, and searchable sound browser on the right.
- Swipe left/right or use arrows to browse KICKS, SNARES, CLAPS, RIMS, HATS, 808s and other categories; verify all factory and imported sounds appear.
- Drag a sample onto the channel rack (or tap its + button). Check that its new track name animates from a circle to an oval. Add the same sample twice: both tracks should have independent notes and MUTE/SOLO/level/pan/tune/decay.
- Add up to 12 tracks, try a 13th, remove a track, then add another. Check that no notes leak between channels.
- Tap 16-step buttons, change bars, edit velocity, and expand the left track arrow to edit pitched notes in the inline piano roll. Verify audio, playback and MIDI output.
- Switch the original instrument faceplate: Modern = red active steps on dark, Platinum = red on silver, Vintage = pale yellow on cream, Texture = blue on blue. Check that the control positions do not move.
- Verify the existing faceplate PLAY/record, DAW FOLLOW, MIDI playback and AUv3 in Logic Pro for iPad still work, with low CPU.

Report any sound loading delays, stuck notes, crashes, wrong sample types or visual jumps.
